card.name: Space before a phone number
card.fires_on: The space right after a phrase like "call", "calling", "or" or "at" that introduces a phone number. The next text is a number such as 911, 988 or a 1-800 line.

modes.label: Call to emergency or crisis line
modes.description: The space after "calling" or "call ... at" just before 911 or 988.
modes.example: Emphasize the importance of calling<< >>911 or getting emergency medical help

modes.label: Information or poison-control number
modes.description: The space before a toll-free 1-800 number after "or" or "Call".
modes.example: Further information is available at www.PIASKYREMS.com or<< >>1-866-4My

card.writes: It promotes dial and call words, which fits a phone number coming next.
card.plain: It fires on the blank spot just before a phone number is given, such as 911 or a 1-800 line.
